narrative.overview: The page is a wall of flat enamel colour fields, each section a full-bleed panel of cobalt, red, yellow, ink or white. Facts about Ferdinand are drawn as counted units (figures, crates, stacked bars, a podium) with ghost units for the unfilled remainder, so a number reads as a quantity before it reads as a numeral. The world refuses the dark-neon portfolio default: there are no shadows, no gradients, no glows and no rounded cards.
keyCharacteristics: Five flat fields (cobalt, signal red, sun yellow, ink, white) with square corners and zero shadows.
Heavy League Spartan caps for display; Atkinson Hyperlegible for everything read at length.
One pictogram sprite in a single weight (figure, sheet, crate, podium, medal) used as counted units.
A segmented section-progress rail across the top replaces the browser scroll bar.
Circle discs and quarter-discs are the only curves; everything else is a rectangle.

rules.name: The Field Pairing Rule
rules.body: Every field sets its own text colour and focus colour: white text on cobalt, red and ink (focus yellow on cobalt and ink, white on red); ink text on yellow and white (focus cobalt). Text never moves to a new field without taking that field's pairing.

rules.name: The Flat Enamel Rule
rules.body: Colour is applied as solid blocks only. Depth is never simulated with shadow, blur or gradient.

rules.name: The Heavy Caps Rule
rules.body: Display and headline text is always uppercase League Spartan at weight 800 or 900. Mixed-case display type does not appear.

rules.name: The Readable Text Rule
rules.body: Anything longer than a label is Atkinson Hyperlegible at 1rem or larger; secondary copy uses the paired muted token, never opacity.

rules.name: The No Shadow Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow. Separation comes from a contrasting field, a 3px ink rule or a dashed outline.

dos: Do build every surface from solid fields in cobalt (#1f4fd8), signal red (#d62e1f), sun yellow (#ffc61a), ink (#14110f) and white.
Do keep corners square; use circles only for discs.
Do express quantities as counted pictogram units with a ghost unit for the remainder.
Do set the field's own focus colour and secondary text token when placing content on a new field.
Do use League Spartan 800 or 900 in uppercase for headings and Atkinson Hyperlegible for all running text.
donts: Don't add shadows, gradients, glows, blurs or rounded cards.
Don't use dark-neon portfolio tropes: aurora, grid backdrops, tickers, crosshairs, loaders or text scramble.
Don't use opacity to make secondary text; use the muted token for the field.
Don't introduce a new accent hue; the three primaries are the whole chromatic range.
Don't replace the pictogram units with generic stock icons.
